name: GraphSL
description: An open-source library bundled with benchmark datasets and evaluation tools for graph source-localization algorithms.
general_score_metric: localization accuracy (primary) and average localization error
reputation: Open-source library published in JOSS; respected as a useful toolkit within a niche of graph-analysis and source-localization researchers.
notes: May rely on synthetic networks and specific diffusion/spread assumptions; results can be sensitive to graph size and model assumptions. Non-LLM benchmark.
